blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.productOption` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.
This is available starting from [Medusa v2.16.0](https://github.com/medusajs/medusa/releases/tag/v2.16.0).

This method creates a product option. It sends a request to the
[Create Option](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#product-options\_postproductoptions)
API route.

types.description: The details of the option to create.

children.name: values
children.description: The option's values.

children.name: ranks
children.description:
The rank for each option value. The keys are the option values,
and the values are their respective ranks.

children.name: is_exclusive
children.description:
Whether the option is exclusive to a specific product,
or can be shared across multiple products.
